description_en: Queries the information about a specified co-streaming session by calling GetConference, including the co-streaming title and status. You can also query the recording URL after the co-streaming session ends
description_zh: 调用GetConference查询指定连麦信息，包含连麦标题和连麦状态。也可查询连麦结束后的录制地址
name: GetConference

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the co-streaming session. The value consists of letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and is 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 连麦唯一标识。由字母、数字和短横线（-）组成，长度为36个字符
parameters.name: conference_id

AppId.description_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits, and is 6 characters in length
AppId.description_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符

ConferenceId.description_en: The unique identifier of the co-streaming session, returned by calling CreateConference. The value consists of letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and is 36 characters in length
ConferenceId.description_zh: 连麦唯一标识，由调用CreateConference返回。由字母、数字和短横线（-）组成，长度为36个字符

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the co-streaming session was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 连麦创建时间戳，单位：毫秒
CreateTime.title_en: 会议创建时间戳，单位：毫秒。
CreateTime.title_zh: 会议创建时间戳，单位：毫秒。

PlaybackUrl.description_en: The recording playback URL in M3U8 format. The URL is generated 10 seconds after the co-streaming session ends
PlaybackUrl.description_zh: 录制回放地址，m3u8格式，连麦结束后10秒才会生成
PlaybackUrl.title_en: 录制回放地址，m3u8格式，会议结束后10秒才会生成。
PlaybackUrl.title_zh: 录制回放地址，m3u8格式，会议结束后10秒才会生成。

RoomId.description_en: The unique identifier of the room. The value can be up to 36 characters in length
RoomId.description_zh: 房间唯一标识，最大长度36个字符

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:
Init: Not started. 
Start: Co-streaming in progress.
End: Co-streaming ended
Status.description_zh:
状态。取值：
Init：未开始。 
Start：连麦中。
End：连麦结束

Title.description_en: The conference title. The title supports both Chinese and English characters and can be up to 128 characters in length
Title.description_zh: 会议标题，支持中英文，最大长度128个字符

UserId.description_en: The user who created the co-streaming session. The value is unique within the AppId. The value consists of letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@), and is 1 to 36 characters in length
UserId.description_zh: 创建连麦的用户，在AppId下单独唯一。英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符
